DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図の前でお困りですか。行きたい場所を指してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the map? Please point to where you want to go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この休憩所に友人がいます。私は少し歩いて戻りたいのですが、地図の右へ進むと目の前の建物にぶつかりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩所の友人の所へ戻る散歩を希望し図の右が建物と重なって見えると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is at this rest area. I want to walk a little and return, but going right on the map seems to lead straight into the building in front of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a walk returning to your friend at the rest area, explaining that the map's right side seems to overlap the building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の上を、ご自分の正面だと思っていませんか。目の前の休憩所は、図では下側に描かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you been assuming the top of the map is directly in front of you? The rest area ahead is drawn at the bottom of the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ずっと上が前だと思っていました。図を持っているつもりで、休憩所が正面に来る向きに合わせて考えてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図の上を正面と誤解していたと伝え休憩所に合わせて向きを考えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I kept thinking the top meant forward. May I imagine holding the map and orient it so the rest area lines up in front of me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the top for forward and ask about orienting it to the rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。向きを合わせると、花壇へ続く道はご自分の左側です。一周する道と、花壇で折り返す道があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Once aligned, the path to the flower beds is on your left. There is a circular route and a route turning back at the flower beds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長く歩くと疲れるので、一周せず花壇で折り返します。途中で座れるところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 疲れやすいため花壇で折り返す道を選び途中の座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Long walks tire me, so I will turn back at the flower beds rather than circle around. Is there somewhere to sit along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the flower-bed return route because you tire easily, and ask about seats along the way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図では、休憩所と花壇の間にベンチの印があります。ここで休んでから戻ることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This map shows a bench between the rest area and flower beds. You can rest there before returning too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベンチで休む場合も、来た道を戻れば休憩所ですね。似た屋根の別の建物と間違えない目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチから来た道を戻ると確認し似た建物と区別する目印を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if I rest on the bench, returning the way I came takes me to the rest area, right? Please tell me a landmark to distinguish it from another building with a similar roof.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm returning the way you came from the bench, and request a landmark distinguishing similar buildings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人のいる休憩所には、入口に丸い時計があります。戻ったら時計と入口の表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your friend's rest area has a round clock at its entrance. When you return, check the clock and entrance sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左の道から花壇まで行き、疲れたら途中のベンチで休みます。戻るときは丸い時計のある休憩所を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左の道で花壇へ往復し必要ならベンチで休み丸い時計の休憩所へ戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the left path to the flower beds and rest on the bench if tired. On return, I will identify the rest area with the round clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm going to the flower beds and back by the left path, resting if needed, and returning to the round-clock rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その往復で考えてください。無理せず、休憩所でお友達と合流なさってください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Plan on that return route. Do not overexert yourself, and meet your friend at the rest area. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の遅れについては、こちらの案内をご覧いただけます。どの列車をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can check train-delay information here. Which train are you waiting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この切符の列車です。研修の集合に遅れそうなので、いつ出るか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符の列車を示し、研修の集合に遅れそうなので出発時刻を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The train on this ticket. I may be late for the training meeting, so I want to know when it leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the ticketed train and say you need the departure time because you may be late for training. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の案内には設備点検中とあり、出発時刻はまだ出ていません。研修先への連絡はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current notice says equipment inspection is in progress, and no departure time has been announced. Have you contacted the training venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。「何分遅れます」と言えないときは、どんな状況だと伝えればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着の遅れを分数で言えない状況で、研修先への伝え方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. If I cannot say how many minutes late I will be, what situation should I explain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to explain the situation to the training venue when you cannot state the delay in minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出発の見通しがまだ出ていない、とお伝えになってはいかがですか。到着時刻のお約束はできません。ほかの経路も調べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could say there is no departure estimate yet. We cannot promise an arrival time. Would you like us to check another route too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きな荷物があるので、乗り換えが増える経路は避けたいです。今の切符で待つ場合と比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きな荷物のため乗り換えの多い経路を避け、現在の切符で待つ場合との比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have large luggage, so I want to avoid routes with more transfers. Can you compare alternatives with waiting on my current ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a comparison with waiting on your current ticket, avoiding many transfers because of large luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 目的地までの接続と切符の条件を分けて調べます。別の経路でも早く着くとは限りません。先に先方へ連絡なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check connections to your destination separately from ticket conditions. Another route may not arrive sooner. Would you contact them first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。先方に遅れる事情を伝えてから、ここで次の案内を待ちます。更新はどこを見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 研修先へ事情を連絡してから待つと決め、情報の更新を見る場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will explain the delay, then wait here for the next information. Where should I look for updates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to inform the training venue before waiting and ask where to see updates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この表示と放送でお知らせします。離れる場合は、戻ってから新しい情報をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will update this display and announcements. If you leave, check the latest information when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、待合スペースで電話をします。出発時刻が出たか、戻ったときにもう一度尋ねてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待合スペースで電話した後に、出発時刻が決まったか再度尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will make a call in the waiting area. When I return, may I ask again whether a departure time has been set?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after calling in the waiting area, you want to ask again whether departure is set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: もちろんです。お戻りの際にこの窓口へどうぞ。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course. Come back to this counter. Take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談のお申し込みですね。今日お持ちになった通知について、急いで確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to arrange a consultation. Is there anything urgent to check about the notice you brought today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知に来週の金曜日までとあります。相談の予約も、その日まで待ってよいという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知にある来週金曜という日付が、相談予約を待てる期限なのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says until next Friday. Does that mean I can wait until then even to book the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether next Friday on the notice is the deadline until which booking the consultation can wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そこは回答期限と書かれています。相談日とは別ですので、担当へ早めに問い合わせましょう。内容のどの部分が難しいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That says reply deadline. It is separate from the consultation date, so let us contact the staff promptly. Which part is difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「該当する欄に記入」の意味がわからず、空欄のままです。間違えて出す前に説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 「該当する欄に記入」が理解できず空欄なので、提出前に説明を受けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not understand 'complete the applicable field,' so I have left it blank. I want an explanation before submitting it incorrectly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you do not understand the applicable-field instruction and left it blank, wanting an explanation before submitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わからない箇所に印を付けて、相談内容として伝えられます。ご希望の日時や、説明の受け方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can mark the unclear part and include it in the consultation request. Do you prefer a date, time, or way of receiving explanations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水曜日の午後なら来られます。電話より、文章で予約の返事をいただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水曜午後の相談を希望し、予約の返答は電話より文章で受け取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come Wednesday afternoon. A written reply about the booking would help more than a phone call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request Wednesday afternoon and a written booking response rather than a phone call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望としてお預かりします。空き状況を担当が調べてからの返答になります。日本語の説明についてもご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that preference. The staff will reply after checking availability. Any preferences about Japanese explanations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 難しい言葉を短く言い換えてほしいです。通訳が頼めるかどうかも、返事のときに教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 難しい語の言い換えを希望し、通訳を頼めるかも回答時に知らせてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please briefly rephrase difficult words. Please also tell me in the reply whether an interpreter can be requested.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request simpler rephrasing and information in the reply about whether an interpreter can be arranged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明のご希望と通訳についての質問を、申込内容に加えました。期限のことも添えます。ここまでの内容をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I added your explanation preferences and interpreter question to the application, along with the deadline. Please review what we have so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水曜午後はまだ予約確定ではなく、返事を待つのですね。回答期限に間に合わないおそれがあることも、この一行に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約が未確定であると確認し、通知の回答期限に間に合わないおそれを申込内容に追記してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: So Wednesday afternoon is not confirmed yet, and I wait for the reply. Please add in this line that I may miss the notice's reply deadline too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the booking is unconfirmed and ask to add the risk of missing the notice's reply deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 追記しました。この控えをお持ちください。予約の回答と通知への対応は別々にご確認ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Added. Please keep this copy. Check the booking response separately from responding to the notice. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計の書類をお持ちですね。お帰りになる前に、何か気になることがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have payment documents. Was there something you wanted to ask before leaving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場から「今日受診したことがわかるもの」を出すように言われました。この領収書だけで足りるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場から受診した証明を求められたことを伝え、領収書で足りるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace told me to submit something showing that I attended today. Is this receipt alone enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your workplace requested proof of the medical visit and ask whether the receipt is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が何を受け付けるかは、こちらでは決められません。診断名まで必要だと言われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot decide what your workplace accepts. Were you told that a diagnosis is required too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまでは言われていません。病名を出す必要があるのか、先に職場に聞き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病名を求められたわけではないと説明し、職場に必要性を聞き直す意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They did not say that. I want to ask my workplace first whether I need to disclose the illness name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no illness name was requested and say you will ask the workplace whether it is necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受診日がわかればよいのか、医師の判断を記載した書類が必要なのかを分けて聞くとよいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may help to ask separately whether confirming the visit date suffices or a document giving the doctor's assessment is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「受診日の確認だけでよいですか」と尋ねてみます。もし医師の書類が必要なら、どこに相談するのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場には受診日の確認で足りるか尋ねると述べ、医師の書類が必要な場合の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask whether confirming the visit date is enough. If a doctor's document is needed, where do I ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the workplace about visit-date confirmation and ask the contact for a doctor's document if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の受付担当へおつなぎします。作成の可否や内容は医師への確認が必要です。料金や日数も、書類が特定できてから尋ねましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can connect you with document reception. The doctor must confirm whether it can be prepared and its contents. Ask fees and days once the document is identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日中にもらえると決めつけずに、職場の指定を確認してから受付へ相談する、という順番ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 即日受け取れると考えず、職場の指定を確認した後で書類受付へ相談する順番を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should not assume I can receive it today; first confirm the workplace's specification, then consult document reception, in that order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm checking the workplace's specification before document reception, without assuming same-day receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうです。今お持ちの領収書は、その間なくさないよう保管してください。受付へ伝える質問をメモしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Keep your receipt safely meanwhile. Shall I note the questions for reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。書類の名称、費用、受取時期の三つを書いてください。領収書はこの封筒に戻して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類名・費用・受取時期をメモにしてもらい、領収書を封筒へ戻して保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. Write three: document name, fee, and collection timing. I will return the receipt to this envelope and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for notes on document name, cost, and collection timing, and say you will keep the receipt in the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 質問を三つ書きましたので、このメモもお持ちください。必要な書類がわかったら受付へご相談ください。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I wrote the three questions. Take this note too. Once you know the required document, consult reception. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談ですね。どのような物をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a lost-property question. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 黒い長い傘をなくしました。持ち手に青いテープが巻いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黒い長傘をなくしたことと、持ち手の青いテープという識別点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost a long black umbrella. It has blue tape around the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a lost long black umbrella with blue tape as an identifying feature on the handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 特徴を書き留めます。最後に傘を持っていたことを覚えているのは、いつ、どこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will note its features. When and where do you last remember having it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼に買い物をした店を出たときは持っていました。その後、バス停のベンチに置いたかもしれませんが、確かではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店を出た時は傘を持っていたという記憶と、バス停のベンチに置いた可能性を区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had it when I left the shop after shopping at midday. I may have put it on the bus-stop bench afterward, but I am not sure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the certain memory of having it on leaving the shop from the possibility of leaving it on a bus-stop bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店を出たときの記憶は確かで、ベンチは可能性ということですね。こちらの一覧に黒い長傘がありますが、テープについては記録がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So leaving the shop is certain, and the bench only possible. Our list has a long black umbrella, but no tape is recorded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒い傘というだけでは、自分の物か判断できません。青いテープのほかに、先端に小さなへこみもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一覧の黒い傘だけでは自分の物と判断できないと伝え、先端のへこみを追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Black alone does not establish it is mine. Besides the blue tape, there is a small dent at the tip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that a black umbrella on the list is not enough to identify yours, and add the dent at the tip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴も照会内容に加えます。今ここでは同じ物だとは言えません。見つかった場合の連絡先をお伺いしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will add that feature to the inquiry. We cannot say now that it is the same item. May we have contact details if it is found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この用紙に携帯番号を書きます。仕事中は出られないので、折り返す際に使う受付番号も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡用携帯番号を記入すると伝え、仕事中に応答できないため折り返し用の受付番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write my mobile number here. I cannot answer at work, so I also want the reception number to quote when calling back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will enter your mobile contact and request a report number for returning calls you cannot answer at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この控えの番号で、今回のご相談をお伝えください。連絡先の数字に誤りがないか、最後に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Use the number on this copy to identify this consultation. Finally, please check the contact digits are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最後の数字は六です。合っています。傘が家で見つかったときも、この番号を伝えて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話番号の末尾が六で正しいと確認し、自宅で傘が見つかった場合も受付番号で連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The last digit is six. It is correct. If I find the umbrella at home, I will also call and quote this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the phone number ends in six and say you will quote the report number if found at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先を確認しました。家で見つかった場合も、そのようにお知らせください。控えを忘れずにお持ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Contact confirmed. Please tell us that way if found at home too. Do not forget the copy. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。お荷物の受け取りで、どの点をお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. What would you like us to check about receiving the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宛名が旧姓になっています。私宛ての荷物だと思うのですが、このまま受け取れるのか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票が旧姓宛てであることを説明し、受け取れるか不安だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is addressed to my former surname. I think it is for me, but worry whether I can collect it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the notice uses your former surname and you are worried whether you can collect it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名と確認書類のお名前が異なるのですね。まず不在票を拝見します。今のお名前が載った書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The addressee differs from your identification name. Let me see the notice first. Do you have a document with your current name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の姓の書類はありますが、旧姓とのつながりがわかるものは家です。今日は受け取れると思って来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の姓の書類はあるが旧姓との関係がわかる書類は自宅だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have current-surname documents, but the document linking it to my former surname is at home. I came expecting to collect it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain current-surname documents are here but proof linking the former surname is at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここでは受け渡しを確約できません。荷物の種類と必要な書類を担当へ照会します。保管期限にもご不安がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot guarantee handover here. We will ask the staff about the parcel type and required documents. Are you concerned about the storage deadline too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日が期限と書いてあります。必要な書類を取りに帰る前に、間に合う方法を担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保管期限が明日なので、帰宅して書類を取る前に間に合う方法を担当者へ尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says tomorrow. Before going home for documents, I want the staff to tell me how I can make it in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the storage deadline is tomorrow and you want to ask how to meet it before returning home for documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在票に載った担当先へ、期限と宛名の相違を一緒に伝えましょう。期限の延長ができるかは、回答を待つ必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us tell the contact on the notice about both the deadline and name mismatch. Whether an extension is possible requires their reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 延長を前提にはしません。差出人にも旧姓で送ったか確認するので、不在票の番号をメモしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限延長を前提にせず、差出人にも確認するため不在票の番号を控えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume an extension. I will also ask the sender whether they used my former surname; may I note the notice number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume an extension and ask to note the notice number to check with the sender too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。番号はこちらです。照会では、旧姓の宛名、現在のお名前、期限が明日という順にお話しになると整理しやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the number is here. For the inquiry, explaining the old-surname addressee, current name, then tomorrow's deadline will organize things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その三点をメモしました。必要書類と受け取れる場所の返事を聞いてから、家へ戻るか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名の相違・現在の名前・明日の期限を控え、書類と受取場所の回答を聞いてから帰宅を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noted those three points. I will decide whether to go home after hearing the required documents and collection location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you recorded the name difference, current name, and tomorrow's deadline, and will decide about going home after the document/location reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、不在票をお返しします。担当先の回答を聞いてからお動きください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the notice back. Act after hearing the responsible contact's reply. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードに関するお急ぎのご相談と伺いました。どのような状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand this is urgent advice about a card. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: キャッシュカードが見当たりません。探し続けるより先に、利用を止める相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: キャッシュカードが見当たらず、捜索を続ける前に利用停止を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find my cash card. Before continuing to search, I want to discuss blocking its use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the cash card is missing and you want to discuss blocking it before further searching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止の担当へおつなぎします。カードの番号がわかる控えはお手元にありますか。暗証番号はおっしゃらないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will connect you with the blocking staff. Do you have a record of the card number? Do not tell us your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号の控えはありません。通帳は家にありますが、この本人確認書類は持っています。これで相談を始められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号の控えと通帳は手元にないが本人確認書類はあると伝え、相談を始められるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No number record. My passbook is at home, but I have this identification. Can I start the consultation with it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say no number record or passbook is at hand, but you have identification, and ask to start the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認をご案内します。ここで番号を推測していただく必要はありません。最後にカードを使った状況は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will explain the checks needed. You need not guess the number here. Do you remember the last time you used the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に現金を引き出して、その後は使っていません。さっき履歴に覚えのない表示を見たので、それも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日夕方の現金引出し後は使っていないことと、覚えのない履歴表示も相談したいことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I withdrew cash yesterday evening and have not used it since. I saw an unfamiliar entry in the history just now and want to ask about it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not used it since yesterday evening's withdrawal and want to discuss an unfamiliar history entry too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示だけで不正利用とは判断できませんので、内容を担当へお伝えください。まず停止についての確認を進め、その後の相談事項も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: An entry alone does not establish unauthorized use; explain the details to staff. First we will check blocking, then record the further questions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その順番でお願いします。再発行も気になりますが、まず停止の手続きが済んだか、はっきり聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再発行より停止確認を優先し、停止手続きが完了したか明確に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please use that order. Reissue also concerns me, but first I want to ask clearly whether blocking has been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize block confirmation over reissue and ask explicitly whether the blocking procedure is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から完了の説明を受けるまでは、済んだとは考えないでください。もし後からカードが見つかった場合の扱いも、そこで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not assume it is complete until the staff explain completion. Also ask there what to do if the card is found later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止が済んだかと、見つかったカードをどう扱うかの二点を聞きます。履歴は人に見られない場所で担当の方に見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止完了と発見後のカードの扱いを質問すると整理し、履歴は人目を避けて担当者に見せたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask two things: whether blocking is done, and how to handle the card if found. I want to show the history to staff somewhere others cannot see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize questions about completed blocking and a found card, and request privacy when showing the history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの相談席へご案内します。履歴と二つの質問を担当に引き継ぎます。この窓口でのお話は以上です。お足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will guide you to this consultation seat and pass on the history and two questions. That concludes this counter's discussion. Watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの商品についてお伺いします。どの部分にお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me ask about the product you brought. What is wrong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った二個組の保存容器です。一つは閉まるのに、もう一つはふたが浮いてしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二個組の保存容器のうち一つだけふたが浮いて閉まらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A pair of storage containers bought yesterday. One closes, but the other's lid lifts and will not seal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only one lid in the two-container set lifts and will not close. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 容器とふたを並べて見せていただけますか。使った後に気づかれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you lay out the containers and lids? Did you notice after using them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食べ物を入れる前に洗い、乾いてから気づきました。二つのふたを入れ替えても、こちらだけ閉まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品を入れる前に洗って乾かした後に気づき、ふたを入れ替えても同じ容器が閉まらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I washed them before adding food and noticed once dry. Even swapping the two lids, this same container will not close.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you noticed after washing and drying before food use, and the same container fails after swapping lids. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 組み合わせを替えても同じ容器が閉まらないのですね。強く押さず、そのままの状態で確認させてください。お買い上げの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The same container fails even with swapped lids. Do not press hard; let us check it as it is. Do you have a purchase record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このレシートにあります。外箱も持ってきましたが、内側の袋は捨てました。それでも状態を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートと外箱はあるが内袋は処分したと伝え、状態を見てもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is on this receipt. I brought the outer box but discarded the inner bag. Can you still inspect the condition?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the receipt and outer box but discarded the inner bag, and request inspection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状態は拝見できます。袋がないことも含めて担当へ伝え、対応を確認します。交換と返金のどちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can inspect it. We will tell the staff about the missing bag too and check options. Would you prefer exchange or refund?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使える物と交換するのが希望です。ただ、同じ不具合がないか、その場でふたの閉まり方を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正常な商品への交換を希望し、交換するならその場でふたの閉まり方を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Exchange for a usable item. But if exchanged, I want to test the lid closing there to check it does not have the same fault.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a functioning replacement and to check its lid closure on the spot if exchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を担当に伝えます。交換できるか、在庫があるかも含めた確認になります。お預かりする前に、品物の数を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will convey that preference, checking whether exchange is possible and stock available. Before taking it, let us count together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器二つ、ふた二つ、外箱一つです。レシートも渡しますので、何を預けたか控えに書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器二つ・ふた二つ・外箱一つとレシートを預けると整理し、預かり内容を控えに書いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Two containers, two lids, one outer box. I will give the receipt too; could you list what you received on the copy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: List two containers, two lids, one box, and the receipt, and request a written record of what was handed over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この品目を控えに書きました。こちらをお持ちください。担当の説明までは交換確定ではありません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I listed the items on this copy. Keep it. Exchange is not confirmed until the staff explain. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の道をお探しですか。今日は奥の道に落ち葉が多いという注意を出しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Looking for a walking route? Today we warn of many fallen leaves on the paths farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 久しぶりに歩くので、滑りやすそうな道は避けたいです。入口の近くで少し歩ける所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 久しぶりの散歩なので滑りそうな道を避け、入口付近で短く歩ける場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not walked for a while, so I want to avoid slippery paths. Is there somewhere for a short walk near the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say it has been a while and ask for a short walk near the entrance avoiding slippery paths. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図では手前の広場までが短い道です。奥へ回る道とは分かれています。どのくらい歩くおつもりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The short path on this map goes to the nearby square. It branches away from the route farther in. How long do you plan to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休みながら二十分くらいにしたいです。広場まで行って疲れたら、そこで座れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩込みで二十分ほど歩きたいと伝え、広場で疲れたときに座れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: About twenty minutes including rests. If I reach the square and am tired, can I sit there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say about twenty minutes including rest and ask whether you can sit if tired at the square. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場には図の丸印の所にベンチがあります。ただ、空いているとは限りません。長く歩くより、手前で折り返すことも考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are benches at the circles on the map, but they may be occupied. Consider turning back earlier instead of walking longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で疲れたら、席を探して歩き続けずに戻ります。この線は一周する道ですか。それとも行き止まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中で疲れたら席を探して歩き続けず戻ると伝え、図の線が周回路か行き止まりか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If tired on the way, I will return rather than keep walking to find a seat. Is this line a circular route or a dead end?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will return if tired instead of continuing to seek a seat, and ask whether the line is a circuit or dead end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その線は奥を回る周回路です。落ち葉の注意があるのもその区間です。今日は短い道を往復すれば、そこを通らずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is the circuit farther in, also the section with the leaf warning. A return trip on the short path avoids it today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では周回路には入らず、短い道を往復します。帰りに別の入口へ出ないよう、今いる入口に印を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注意のある周回路へ入らず短い道を往復すると決め、同じ入口へ戻るため現在地の印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will avoid the circuit and go back along the short path. Please mark this entrance so I do not leave by another one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the short return route outside the warned circuit, and request a current-location mark to return to the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この紙の図に現在地と折り返す場所を記しました。途中の分かれ道では、奥へ向かわず来た道へ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I marked your location and turnaround on this paper map. At forks, return the way you came instead of going farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図を持って、分かれ道からは来た道を戻ります。二十分にこだわらず、足が疲れる前に切り上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙の図を持って分かれ道では来た道を戻り、二十分に固執せず疲れる前に切り上げると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the map and return the same way at forks. I will not insist on twenty minutes, but finish before my legs get tired.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will carry the paper map, return the same way at forks, and stop before fatigue without insisting on twenty minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その計画で、ご無理のない範囲でどうぞ。足元と周囲を見ながらお歩きください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Use that plan within your ability. Watch your footing and surroundings. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二名分のご相談ですね。お二人とも、こちらの乗り場からご乗車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is for two people. Are you both boarding at this stop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私はここからですが、友人は別の乗り場から乗りたいと言っています。同じ申込みにまとめられるか分からなくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と友人の乗り場が違うと説明し、一つの申込みにまとめられるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am, but my friend wants another stop. I came because I do not know whether we can combine it into one application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain different boarding stops and ask whether they can be combined into one application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、それぞれの乗り場を分けて確認します。ご友人から、停留所の正式な表示を聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first check each stop separately. Has your friend given the stop's official sign name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メッセージには「広場」とだけあります。似た名前を選んで間違えるといけないので、友人に表示を聞き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の情報が広場だけで曖昧だと伝え、停留所表示を本人に聞き直したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The message just says 'square.' Rather than choose a similar name and be wrong, I want to ask them for the sign again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the friend's information is only a vague 'square' and you want the exact stop sign from them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうしましょう。ご友人の分は未確定としておきます。お客様お一人の相談だけ先に進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us do that. Your friend's portion will remain unconfirmed. Shall we proceed just with your own consultation first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の分だけ先にお願いします。同行者欄に二人と書いたメモは、この場で直しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分一人分の相談を先に希望し、二人と書いたメモを訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do mine first. I will correct the note where I wrote two people in the companion field now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request your own consultation first and say you will correct the two-person note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メモは一人分になりました。確認する便はこちらの候補でよろしいですか。まだ発券はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The note now says one. Is this the proposed service to check? No ticket has been issued yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この候補で合っています。ただ、友人と同じ車両になるかは、まだ決まっていないという理解です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補便は合っていると答え、友人と同じ車両になるかは未確定と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This candidate is right. But I understand being on the same vehicle as my friend is still undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the proposed service is right but sharing the friend's vehicle remains unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ご友人の乗車場所が分かってから、便を合わせられるか調べます。今、購入まで進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, after learning their boarding point, we will check whether services can be matched. Do you want to proceed to purchase now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入はいったん待ちます。二人の乗り場と便がそろってから、それぞれの申込み内容を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入を待ち、二人の乗り場と便が分かってから個別の申込み内容を確かめると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait to purchase. Once both stops and services are clear, I want to check each application separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wait for purchase and check separate applications after both stops and services are known. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では相談内容だけ控えます。ご友人の停留所名が分かったら、こちらのメモをお持ちください。お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will record only the consultation. Once your friend's stop name is known, bring this note. We look forward to seeing you.
